# Conflict Management - HYtalent

## Training Programs Offered

## Conflict Management

Conflict at work is inevitable,but it doesn’t have to be destructive. It is very natural to have conflicts in an organisation. When passionate people with different perspectives collaborate to address a problem or an opportunity, there can be give-and-take and productive disagreement. The most effective people are those who can disagree constructively, not destructively, and keep difficult conversations substantive, not personal. This module helps the participants to develop the skill to navigate a conflict and turn it into a productive situation.

### Key Takeaways

- Understanding the possible sources of conflicts
- Assessing the downsides of conflict
- Knowing the ways to deal with different types of conflict
- Knowing your natural conflict management style using Conflict Resolution Inventory
- Getting ready mentally, strategically and logistically for dealing with a conflict
- Knowing when to go for third party interventions
- Getting a resolution done
- Repairing relationships

## Locus of Control

Locus of Control is the perceived source of control over behaviour. People with internal locus of control believe that their skill, ability, and efforts determine the bulk of their life experiences. In contrast, people with external locus of control believe that their lives are determined mainly by sources outside them like fate, chance, luck or powerful others. These perceptions greatly determine the behaviour of people. This module helps the participants to understand whether they have internality or externality so that they can alter their attitude.

### Key Takeaways

- Role of Locus of Control in individual and organizational context
- Internal Locus vs External Locus

- Striking right balance between Internal Locus and External Locus for better outcomes

It is not easy to achieve work-life balance in today’s unpredictable and fast paced work environment. As we grow increasingly connected through technology and social media, it has become more and more difficult to separate work from personal lives. Maintaining a healthy work-life balance is not only important for health and relationships, but it can improve the productivity and performance of human resources in an organisation. This module mainly focuses on understanding how to strike a right balance between work and life using various approaches.

### Key Takeaways

- Understanding the important variables in WLB
- Knowing your present level of efficiency in handling WLB using a psychometric scale
- Understanding the role of organizations in facilitating WLB
- Understanding the role of an employee in achieving WLB
- Clearing the roadblocks
- Knowing various options to achieve WLB
- Evaluating an organisation culture in terms of WLB
